name: Crouch the torso
description: Lower the torso lift to its bottom (or a requested height) for floor and low-shelf work.

height_m.description: Optional torso joint target in [-0.54, 0]; omit for the lowest.

verifier.name: torso_raised
verifier.meaning: Torso lift within 3 cm of its highest position (travel height).
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.name: torso_at
verifier.meaning: Torso lift joint within 2 cm of the requested position (0 = top, -0.54 = bottom).
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.name: torso_lowered
verifier.meaning: Torso lift within 3 cm of its lowest position (floor reach).
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving

relations.when: the object is on the floor or a low shelf

failure.automatic_fallback: nested calls only: a failed precondition with a matching repair fallback runs the repair once and retries; top-level calls stop
